name: Cluedo
description: Classic mystery game where players deduce who committed a murder, with which weapon, and in which room.

name: Monopoly
description: Property trading game where players buy, sell, and develop properties to bankrupt opponents.

name: Snakes and Ladders
description: Simple race board game where players climb ladders and slide down snakes to reach the finish.

name: Ludo
description: Classic race game where players move tokens around the board to reach home before opponents.

name: Scrabble Junior
description: Child-friendly version of Scrabble designed to build spelling and vocabulary skills.

name: Guess Who?
description: Deduction game where players ask yes/no questions to identify their opponent's mystery character.

name: Connect 4
description: Strategy game where players drop coloured discs into a grid to connect four in a row.

name: Jenga
description: Dexterity game where players take turns removing blocks from a tower without toppling it.

name: Operation
description: Skill game where players use tweezers to remove ailments from a patient without touching the edges.

name: Hungry Hippos
description: Fast-paced game where players operate hippo levers to gobble up as many marbles as possible.

name: Mouse Trap
description: Players build an elaborate Rube Goldberg-style mouse trap to catch opponents' mice.

name: Articulate! For Kids
description: Team-based description game where players race to describe words on cards without saying the word itself.

name: Dobble
description: Speedy card game where players spot the one matching symbol between any two cards.

name: Uno
description: Card game where players match colours and numbers to shed their hand, using action cards to hinder others.

name: Labyrinth (Junior)
description: Maze puzzle game where players shift tiles to create paths and collect treasures.

name: Buckaroo
description: Players take turns placing items onto a toy mule without causing it to kick everything off.

name: Frustration
description: Race game featuring the iconic Pop-O-Matic bubble dice roller, where players can send opponents back to start.

name: Kerplunk
description: Players take turns removing sticks from a tube full of marbles, trying to drop the fewest marbles.

name: Pictionary Junior
description: Team drawing and guessing game using age-appropriate words and pictures.

name: Pop Up Pirate
description: Players take turns inserting swords into a barrel until the pirate pops up — the one who triggers it loses.
